name: Cat Battles 🐾
desc:
🐱 Push, Slap & Toss Cats Out of the Ring! 🐱
Grab, punch and shove your way to the top. Last cat standing wins!

⚡ Abilities (8)
Dash, Pounce, Hiss, Anchor, Stomp, Catnip, Fluff Up, Hairball

🎨 Collect Rare Furs
Ginger, Tuxedo, Calico, Tiger, Snow Leopard, Gold, Crystal, Rainbow, Galaxy, Glitch & more!

🎮 HOW TO PLAY:
🥊 Punch (Click), Grab (Right Click), Kick (F), Lift (Shift)
🌀 Use your ability with Q!
💰 Earn coins every bout and open crates for furs, sumo gear & emotes
🏟️ Play Classic, 2 Teams or 4 Teams!

🎁 CODES: RELEASE, NEWGAME, CATS
👍 Redeem them for free coins, then give us a 👍 LIKE and ⭐ FAVORITE!

🔔 FOLLOW and FAVORITE for the latest UPDATES! 🔔
